usedFor: Flutterwave records the payments, and TRIGGERcmd runs a command on your computer through “Trigger Command” after each “New Transactions”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Transactions” in Flutterwave, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: A new payment can start a script on your own machine, such as an export or a sound.

watchOut: “New Transactions” is polling, so “Trigger Command” runs after a scheduled check and your computer must be on.
